function.name: get_icon_ptr
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to a cursoricon_object associated with a given handle. If the handle is from another process, it issues a warning and returns NULL.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is the handle for which the cursoricon_object pointer is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: struct cursoricon_object pointer. It represents a pointer to the cursoricon_object associated with the given handle. If the handle is from another process, the function returns NULL.

function.name: process_wine_setcursor
function.description: This function sets the cursor for a specific window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Handle to the window where the cursor will be set

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the cursor

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE after setting the cursor

function.name: NtUserShowCursor
function.description: This function is used to show or hide the cursor based on the boolean value passed to it. It communicates with a server to set the cursor count and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: This parameter is used to decide whether to show or hide the cursor. If true, the cursor is shown, if false, the cursor is hidden.

function.return_type: INT, represents the updated count of the cursor after the show or hide operation

function.name: NtUserSetCursor
function.description: This function sets the cursor to a specified cursor and returns the previous cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: This parameter is the handle to the cursor that is to be set.

function.return_type: HCURSOR, which represents the handle to the previous cursor.

function.name: NtUserGetCursor
function.description: This function is used to get the current cursor.
function.return_type: HCURSOR, which represents the handle to the current cursor

function.name: alloc_cursoricon_handle
function.description: This function allocates a handle for a cursor or icon object and sets its properties.

parameters.name: is_icon
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines if the object is an icon or not.

function.return_type: HICON, which represents the handle to the cursor or icon object.

function.name: get_icon_frame_ptr
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to a specific frame of an animated cursor or icon. If the cursor or icon is not animated, it returns a pointer to the cursor or icon itself.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the icon or cursor.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: This is the index of the frame to be retrieved in case of an animated cursor or icon.

function.return_type: struct cursoricon_object pointer. It represents a pointer to the requested frame of the animated cursor or icon, or to the cursor or icon itself if it is not animated. If the function fails, it returns NULL.

function.name: free_icon_handle
function.description: This function is used to free the memory allocated to an icon handle. It also handles the freeing of associated resources such as frames in case of animated icons, and dispatches a callback after freeing the resources.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is the handle to the icon that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the icon handle was successfully freed, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtUserDestroyCursor
function.description: This function is used to destroy a cursor and free up the resources associated with it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: This is a handle to the cursor to be destroyed.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: This argument is not used in the function.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the cursor was successfully destroyed, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtUserSetCursorIconData
function.description: This function sets the cursor icon data. It initializes the cursor icon object, sets the delay, number of steps, and frames if any. It also sets the resource name and module if provided. If the cursor icon is animated, it sets up the animated frames in the correct sequence. If the flag LR_SHARED is set, it adds the object to the icon cache.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Handle to the cursor icon

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Pointer to the module unicode string

parameters.name: res_name
parameters.description: Pointer to the resource name unicode string

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Pointer to the cursor icon description structure

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the cursor icon data is successfully set, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: NtUserFindExistingCursorIcon
function.description: This function searches for an existing cursor or icon in the icon cache that matches the given module, resource name, and description.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Pointer to the module of the cursor or icon

parameters.name: res_name
parameters.description: Pointer to the resource name of the cursor or icon

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Pointer to the description of the cursor or icon

function.return_type: HICON, represents the handle to the cursor or icon if found, otherwise returns 0

function.name: NtUserGetIconSize
function.description: This function retrieves the dimensions of an icon or cursor.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the icon or cursor

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: The step for which to get the icon frame

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that receives the width of the icon or cursor

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that receives the height of the icon or cursor

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns FALSE and sets the last error to ERROR_INVALID_CURSOR_HANDLE

function.name: NtUserGetCursorFrameInfo
function.description: This function retrieves information about a cursor's animation frame, including the rate at which the frame changes (in jiffies) and the total number of steps in the animation.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Handle to the cursor for which to get frame information.

parameters.name: istep
parameters.description: The index of the step in the cursor's animation sequence.

parameters.name: rate_jiffies
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the rate at which the frame changes, in jiffies.

parameters.name: num_steps
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the total number of steps in the cursor's animation sequence.

function.return_type: HCURSOR. Returns a handle to the cursor if successful, or zero otherwise.

function.name: copy_bitmap
function.description: This function copies a bitmap using the Windows GDI functions. It creates a compatible device context, selects the bitmap into it, creates a new bitmap of the same size, and copies the original bitmap into the new one.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is the original bitmap that will be copied.

function.return_type: HBITMAP, which represents the new copied bitmap. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserGetIconInfo
function.description: This function retrieves information about an icon or a cursor. It gets the icon pointer and frame pointer, checks their validity, and then extracts the icon information. If the icon has a module, it copies the module and resource name to the provided buffers. If not, it sets the lengths of the module and resource name to 0.

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: Handle to the icon or cursor

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to an ICONINFO structure that receives the information about the icon or cursor

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Pointer to a UNICODE_STRING structure that receives the module name

parameters.name: res_name
parameters.description: Pointer to a UNICODE_STRING structure that receives the resource name

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD that receives the color depth of the icon or cursor

parameters.name: unk
parameters.description: Unknown parameter

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the icon information, FALSE otherwise

function.name: NtUserDrawIconEx
function.description: This function draws an icon or cursor into the specified device context, with the ability to modify its dimensions, handle the drawing of the icon's mask and image layers separately, and apply alpha blending if the icon supports it.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context where the icon will be drawn.

parameters.name: x0
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the icon.

parameters.name: y0
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the icon.

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: Handle to the icon to be drawn.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width, in logical units, of the icon. If this parameter is zero, the function uses the SM_CXICON or SM_CXCURSOR system metric value to set the width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height, in logical units, of the icon. If this parameter is zero, the function uses the SM_CYICON or SM_CYCURSOR system metric value to set the height.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: The index of the frame to draw, for animated cursors and icons.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Handle to the brush used for drawing the icon.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies drawing options. It can be zero or a combination of the following values: DI_COMPAT, DI_DEFAULTSIZE, DI_IMAGE, DI_MASK, DI_NOMIRROR, DI_NORMAL.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: get_icon_param
function.description: This function retrieves the parameter of an icon object associated with a given handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the icon object.

function.return_type: ULONG_PTR, represents the parameter of the icon object. If the icon object does not exist or belongs to another process, it returns 0.

function.name: set_icon_param
function.description: This function sets the parameters of an icon object and returns the previous parameter value.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the icon object.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the structure containing the new parameters for the icon object.

function.return_type: ULONG_PTR, represents the previous parameter value of the icon object.

function.name: CopyImage
function.description: This function copies an image and returns a handle to the new image.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the image to be copied.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the image to be copied.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The desired width of the new image.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The desired height of the new image.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Options for the copy operation.

function.return_type: HANDLE, represents a handle to the new image if the copy operation is successful, otherwise returns 0.

function.name: LoadImageW
function.description: This function is used to load an image into memory. It checks if the name is supported in Unix modules, and if not, it returns 0. If the name is supported, it calls the KeUserModeCallback function and returns a pointer to the loaded image if successful.

parameters.name: hinst
parameters.description: Handle to the instance of the module whose executable file contains the image to be loaded

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to a null-terminated string that contains the name of the image resource in the module

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of image to be loaded

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The desired width of the image

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The desired height of the image

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Controls the load options

function.return_type: HANDLE, which represents a pointer to the loaded image if successful, or 0 if not
